name: search_catalogue
title: Search the catalogue
description: Search catalogued legal sources by words in their title, citation or summary, or in one part of their cleared full text. Every word must match a whole word, in any order. Returns metadata, rights status and official links.

query.description: Words to find, such as a title or a citation. Every word must appear; case and punctuation don't matter.

limit.description: How many sources to return, 1 to 25.

jurisdiction.description: One jurisdiction to search, such as rw (Rwanda) or ng (Nigeria). Without it, the search covers every jurisdiction available to you.

name: get_source
title: Get one source
description: Get one catalogued source by its ID, including rights status and access mode.

source_id.description: The source's ID, such as ng-foi-act-2011, from a search.

name: get_relationships
title: Get a source's history
description: Whether a source is current and how it relates to other public sources, one step away: what it repeals, amends or commences and the law it is made under, what repealed, amended or commenced it, the treaty or directive it transposes, domesticates, implements or ratifies and the laws that do so for it, what it cites and is cited by, the instruments made under it, and the source in force in its place now when it has been repealed. For case law: each judgment paragraph that cites a provision or another judgment, with the paragraph's words, and how a judgment follows, applies, distinguishes, doubts or overrules another, or was so treated, where a legally qualified reviewer recorded it (no treatment recorded means none is known, not that there is none). Only links a reviewer has checked against the official text. A page at a time.

source_id.description: The source's ID, such as ng-isa-2007, from a search.

relation_type.description: Only links of this kind, such as repealed_by, enables, cited_by or overruled_by.

locator.description: Only the citations and treatments of this part of the source, or of a part within it: a provision's locator, such as sec_2__subsec_1, for the judgment paragraphs citing it (relation_type cited_by), or a judgment paragraph's, such as para_12.

limit.description: Links per page, 1 to 100. The default is 25.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to continue it.

name: list_expressions
title: List a source's language editions
description: A source's language editions with a published text: for each, its texts, the one to read when no date is given, and what the edition is worth as law as its record states it (authoritative, equally_authentic, official_translation, unofficial_translation or machine_translation, with where that is stated; unknown when nothing is recorded); and the instrument's own rule for which version prevails where its language versions differ (language_rule), or unknown. A preferred text is a reading default, never a claim that its edition is authoritative.

source_id.description: The source's ID, such as ng-foi-act-2011, from a search.

name: get_anchor
title: Get one part of a text exactly
description: One part of a published text, such as a section or article, exactly: its words, its span as UTF-8 byte offsets, the hash of its bytes for checking a quotation, a citation such as s. 23(1)(a), the official file and the attribution its rights record asks for. Never shortened: a part too large for one answer is refused; read it from the REST text route with its offsets.

anchor_id.description: The part's ID, from a text's structure.

name: search_text
title: Search published texts
description: Search the words of published legal texts. Returns matching passages (sections, articles, schedule paragraphs), best first, each with an exact snippet, a citation such as s. 23(1)(a), the part's anchor_id for get_anchor and the record's legal status. Only published texts are searched: coverage says how many records in scope have one, and status tells no_result apart from a scope with no published text (unsupported_scope) and a search that could not run (degraded).

query.description: Words to find. "exact phrase" in quotes, -word to leave out, OR between alternatives. A citation of a part, such as NDPA s. 23(1)(a), puts that part first.

jurisdiction.description: One jurisdiction to search, such as ng (Nigeria). Without it, every jurisdiction available to you.

language.description: Only texts in this language, such as en or fr.

as_of.description: Only texts in force on this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Texts with no effective date are left out.

limit.description: How many passages, 1 to 10. The default is 5.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous answer, for more passages.

scope.description: applicable: also the law that binds in the one jurisdiction given on as_of (today without it): instruments of the African Union and regional bodies it belonged to (reviewed memberships only) and treaties it ratified or acceded to. Each passage then says how it relates to that jurisdiction (applicability), and the answer states what was added and left out. For a place within a country (ng-la), the country's own law too, and the country's memberships and treaties.

name: retrieve_evidence
title: Retrieve legal evidence
description: Ranked legal evidence for a question, to cite in an answer: each unit is a provision (or a law's title and preamble) with its exact words or an excerpt, its anchor_id, byte span and span_hash, its citation such as s. 23(1)(a), the pages of the official file it is on, links to read it on Open Alvary and the official file's address and hash, what quoting it asks for, whether it was in force (currentness, with what that rests on), the definitions it relies on and why it ranks there. A question that cites a part (NDPA s. 24(1)(a), section 24 of the Nigeria Data Protection Act, Part V of the NDPA), names a page of a law (page 18 of the NDPA), is an Open Alvary or official address, names a law or asks what a term means is routed to that first. Quote only the words given; check cited parts with check_currentness before showing an answer.

query.description: The question, such as: when must a data controller report a breach in Nigeria?

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions to search, such as ["ng"]. With two or more, results alternate between them. Without it, every jurisdiction available to you.

language.description: Only texts in this language, such as en or fr.

as_of.description: Only texts in force on this date, YYYY-MM-DD, with currentness assessed at it. Without it, nothing is assumed about the date.

source_id.description: Only this record, such as ng-data-protection-act-2023: then a pinpoint alone (s. 24) or a page (page 18) is read within it.

max_units.description: How many units, 1 to 15. The default is 8.

max_evidence_bytes.description: The most bytes of words, 4,096 to 40,960. The default is 24,576.

scope.description: applicable, with exactly one jurisdiction: also the law that binds there on as_of (today without it): instruments of the African Union and regional bodies it belonged to (reviewed memberships only) and treaties it ratified or acceded to. Each unit then says how it relates to that jurisdiction (applicability: national, regional_direct, treaty_in_force_for_state, unknown and others, with what that rests on), and the answer states what was added and left out. For a place within a country (ng-la), the country's own law too, and the country's memberships and treaties.

name: check_currentness
title: Check cited parts
description: Before showing an answer that cites the corpus: for each cited part, whether it is still published with the same words (unchanged), whether a newer text of the same edition exists (newer_version, with the same part's anchor_id there and whether its words changed), whether the span_hash sent is wrong (span_mismatch) or the part is not public (unavailable); whether it was in force on a date; and, given a jurisdiction, whether the record binds there on that date (applicability: bound, not_bound or unknown, with the memberships, legal effect or treaty party entry it rests on).

items.description: The parts: each an anchor_id, or a version_id with a locator, with the span_hash you hold, an optional as_of date and, to ask whether the record binds in a country on that date, its jurisdiction, such as sn.

name: resolve_citation
title: Resolve a citation
description: The records a citation names and, for a citation of a part such as NDPA s. 23(1)(a), art. 12 or First Schedule, para. 3, the part in the record's public text: its anchor_id for get_anchor and its exact span. Alternatives (two languages, two texts, two records) are listed with the reason, never chosen between.

citation.description: The citation, such as FOI Act 2011, s. 1(1).

as_of.description: Look for the part only in texts in force on this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: Look for the part only in texts in this language, such as en.

name: list_changes
title: List catalogue changes
description: Changes to the catalogue in commit order: records added, corrected or withdrawn, text published, legal effects (repeals, amendments, commencements, transpositions and others a reviewer checked) recorded or withdrawn, reviewed memberships of the African Union and the regional bodies recorded, ended or corrected, and members' suspensions from participation recorded or lifted (a suspended member remains one). Filter by jurisdiction, work, type, document class, language or keyword. Pass the returned resume_token next time to get only newer changes. Changes to what Open Alvary holds, not every change in a country's law.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction IDs, such as ng or rw; a country includes its states, and a body such as aa-ecowas includes changes to its membership and its members' suspensions.

work.description: Source IDs, to follow particular laws.

type.description: Kinds of change: catalogue_added, metadata_corrected, rights_changed, text_version_published, legal_effect_recorded, treatment_recorded, withdrawal, coverage_changed, membership_recorded, suspension_recorded.

class.description: Document types, such as act or regulation.

language.description: Languages of the affected text, such as en.

q.description: Whole words in the title, citation or summary.

resume_token.description: The resume_token of an earlier answer, for only newer changes.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to continue it.

name: get_change
title: Get one change
description: One catalogue change by its event_id.

name: get_coverage
title: Catalogue coverage
description: Counts of catalogued sources and of sources with openly redistributable full text.
